_README: Corrections applied AFTER a TI parametric export is overlaid, for fields where TI's own
selector database is demonstrably wrong. Each entry needs a 'why' recorded so the override
can be re-checked when TI republishes. Keyed by part number with all punctuation stripped
Only override where the evidence is explicit; a narrower recommended envelope is NOT an error.

TPS55287.why: TI's export field says 30, contradicted by its own Description column in the same row ('36V 4A buck-boost converter with I2C interface') and by the datasheet twice: title 'TPS55287 36-V, 4-A Buck-Boost Converter' and body 'has up to 36V input voltage capability' (SLVSGW6, Aug 2024). The resistor-set twin TPS552872 correctly reads 36 in the same export, and TPS55289 genuinely is a 30V part - so the 30 appears to be copied from the TPS55289 row.
